title: Bug: Objectives Resetting Version 3.3.3.0-dev-c
symptom: Upon updating to version 3.3.3.0-dev-c the objectives reset back to objective 1, importing settings does not help. Also, aaps keeps bringing up tidepool (opening a web link to the tidepool sign in page) every several minutes, probably a feature but still annoying that it does so automatically. Also, time since last reading displayed in seconds.
fix: To prevent tidepool login disable tidepool plugin. The objectives reset issue was fixed by a commit.
